blocks.quote: Reports from engineering and research projects.

The registry contains system-level case and research reports that cross multiple patterns. Each report records operating constraints, failure history, architecture decisions, evidence boundaries, and conditions for transfer to another setting.
Dongfang Yiteng · Preserve Business State — Program-managed parameter provenance, task DAGs, and resumable approval for enterprise SaaS workflows.
Xuanxu · Verifiable GIS Publishing — Six-stage pipelines, external map probes, failure-to-rule learning, and certified capability growth.
AI4MBSE · One-Diagram SysML Write-Back — Typed stage artifacts, bounded scope, structural checks, and receipt-backed write-back to an engineering repository.
These cases reconstruct architecture changes from public code, pull requests, tests, and documentation. They are listed separately from contributor-attributed case reports.
DeerFlow · Guardrails and Two-Layer Authorization — From pre-call interception to assembly filtering, trusted identity, RBAC, run-time decisions, and structured evidence.
Deep Agents · Code-Generated Dynamic Collaboration — From the three-layer stack and subagent isolation to interpreter-based orchestration, with a precise boundary from choreography.
Inclusion rule: A report must name its system constraints, implementation decisions, known failures, and limits of transfer. Publication is not product certification.
